Team —

Below is the put-together agenda for ACME's executive workshop on Monday, Nov 24. I pulled speaker preferences from the last call and tried to keep run-time tight for the execs. Please review and confirm where I've put you. Critical asks in bold.

Agenda (60 minutes total + 30-minute optional follow-up):
- 09:00–09:05 — Welcome & goals (Laura)
- 09:05–09:20 — Product priorities & what success looks like (Jordan)
- 09:20–09:35 — Technical approach: inference, routing, SLOs (Vivek)
- 09:35–09:45 — Cost/performance levers (Marissa)
- 09:45–09:55 — Customer Q&A / open items (All)
- 09:55–10:00 — Next steps + mutual action plan (Laura)

Pre-read packet (link below) is short: 1) one-page exec brief, 2) case study of similar deployment, 3) proposed MAP. Please make sure any slide you plan to show is added to the "presenter slides" section of the Drive by EOD Friday.

Attachments: [Attachment: workshop_agenda_v4.pdf (pdf, 420KB)], [Attachment: presenter_bios.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)]
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-workshop-pre-reads
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2025-WORK-01

Asks: 
- Jordan: confirm you can cover the product priorities slot and upload your 3–4 slides.
- Vivek: can you include one slide on fallback strategy & latency SLOs?
- Marissa: bring the cost delta table (full vs quantized + batching) — one slide.
- Stephanie: I'll need a one-pager logistics checklist (travel, AV, attendee list) to forward to ACME.

If I don't hear objections, I'll send this to Emily and Rajiv tomorrow morning with the pre-read link.

—Laura
